viewAllReports: View all execution reports for this case
noInstructionForAiCompile: This step has no natural language instruction; cannot AI-compile it
closeDrawerBeforeUndo: Close the edit drawer before undoing
selectStepsToCopy: Select the steps to copy first
stepModifiedReload: The step was modified; close the drawer and retry
loadRecorderExtension: Please make sure the Chrome recording extension is loaded
selectStartStepFirst: Select "Start from here" in the step list first
resumeNoPreview: Selected — preceding steps will not be replayed
resumeReplayPreview: Selected — preceding steps will be replayed first
incognitoHint: Every replay starts from a fresh session without retaining login state
noEnvOverride: Don't specify at the case level
datasetRunHint: Replay runs once per enabled row, each producing its own report; reference data in steps with {{col}}.
expectedOutcome: Expected outcome (what the final page should look like)
expectedOutcomePlaceholder: e.g. After submitting with empty fields, the login box shows a red prompt 'Please enter your username and password'.
expectedOutcomeHint: Leave empty to skip the case-level vision check; the case passes or fails based only on whether every step succeeded.
expectedOutcomeVarSuffix: referencing dataset columns (with prior extract variables); each row is substituted before judging; do not mark expected columns sensitive.
addStepTitle: Manually add a step (uncompiled steps must be AI-compiled first before they can execute)
pasteAfterSelected: Insert after the last selected step
varCheckTitle: Variable check (does not block saving; undefined variables error at replay)
varForwardRef: Step {{order}} forward-references {{name}} (defined in a later step)
varDuplicate: Variable {{name}} is defined multiple times at steps {{orders}}; replay uses the last assignment
noStepsHint: Click "AI add steps" on the right to have an Agent draft them, or record with the Chrome extension.
recordingInProgress: Recording... Interact with the page opened by the Chrome extension.
compiledActionsTooltip: compiled contains {{count}} actions, executed in order; hover the step text to see the full chain
compiledActionsTooltip_one: compiled contains {{count}} action, executed in order; hover the step text to see the full chain
compiledActionsTooltip_other: compiled contains {{count}} actions, executed in order; hover the step text to see the full chain
extractVarTooltip: Extract a variable for later steps via {{col}}
uncompiledTooltip: This step lacks compiled DSL; replay will be blocked by the dispatcher. Click to jump to the AI assistant to recompile via stage_case_op.
splitTooltip: Split into {{count}} single-action steps (each independently editable)
splitTooltip_other: Split into {{count}} single-action steps (each independently editable)
copyStepTooltip: Copy this step to the next row
uncompiledBlocking: There are {{count}} uncompiled steps; click "AI compile" to fill them first
uncompiledBlocking_one: There is {{count}} uncompiled step; click "AI compile" to fill it first
uncompiledBlocking_other: There are {{count}} uncompiled steps; click "AI compile" to fill them first
deprecatedExecuteConfirm: This case is deprecated; still execute?
goToReportsDesc: All execution reports for this case are aggregated on the reports page.
recordingHistory: Recording history (placeholder; will list each recording session chronologically).
noTagsInProject: No tags in this project yet
urlResolveHint: How the recording target URL resolves: case-relative path + environment web service (default or a named service).
noRequirementHint: This case is not bound to a requirement, so no scenario can be linked.
mobileRecordingHint: Once the backend mobile daemon is running, select entries in the Accessibility Tree on the right to generate steps.
resumeModeHint: Click "Start from here" in the step list to choose the target step.
useInitUrl: Overwrite with the initial navigation URL
recorderExtHint: Load the Chrome recording extension first (apps/recorder/).
relativeUrlPlaceholder: /admin/login (relative path; combined with the environment web service at execution time)
urlHelp: Leave empty to clear the override and let replay resolve via the environment web service. Old absolute URLs still execute directly, but new cases should store a relative path (starting with /).
replayPrecedingHint: When "Replay first" is chosen, the recorder runs all preceding steps first (to continue from an existing login state).
noPreviewHint: Choosing "No preview" starts recording directly from this step without replaying preceding steps.
deleteStepConfirm: Delete step {{order}} "{{instruction}}"? It must be re-recorded or re-edited afterward and cannot be recovered.
aiAddStepsHint: Tell AI which steps to add (leave blank to let AI decide what the case is missing). It first views the real page snapshot; results preview in the StagePanel on the right and are only saved after you confirm.
aiAddStepsPlaceholder: e.g. Go to the home page, click "New order", fill in order number and customer name, submit, then assert that a new row appears in the list
switchAction: Switch action type (compatible fields are preserved)
naturalLanguageDesc: Natural language description (row-level instruction, for humans / as an LLM primer; not read at replay)
instructionRequiredPlaceholder: Required. e.g. Enter the admin account in the username field
locatorCandidates: Locator candidates (tried in order; semantic locators from recording take priority)
sensitiveValue: Sensitive value (password, stored encrypted; plaintext is never shown)
pwdDraftPlaceholder: Enter a new password (the encrypted value is not echoed)
waitNoLocatorHint: No locator candidates = fixed wait for that duration (empty wait), waiting for no element
expectedJson: Expected JSON (deep comparison of the entire value)
extractSmart: Smart extract (generate regex from the description)
samplePrompt: Paste a sample text containing the target snippet
regexGenerated: Regex generated: {{pattern}} (capture group {{group}}, applied at replay after saving)
aiSubInstruction: AI sub-step instruction (compiled into compiled[0].instruction; read over multiple rounds by the LLM at replay)
aiSubPlaceholder: e.g. Read the characters from the captcha image and fill them into the captcha input
aiCompileTooltip: Hand the natural language instruction to the AI assistant; it previews in the StagePanel → confirm to save.
aiStepBullet1: • AI steps are executed by AI reviewing screenshots during replay, suited to interactions hard to pin to DSL such as captcha recognition and dynamic popups.
aiStepBullet2: • For deterministic routine actions, prefer concrete steps such as click / fill / waitFor — more stable and faster.
uploadHint: Bind a replay file (isolated per project, ≤ 10 MB)
orPickUploaded: —— or pick from files already uploaded in this project ——
bundleIdLabel: bundleId (leave empty to launch the default app)
noExtraFieldsHint: This step needs no extra fields; just save.
queryColumnsLabel: Return columns (Ctrl/Cmd to multi-select; empty means *)
saveVarLabel: Extract variable (response value → {{col}}, for later steps)
saveVarPathPlaceholder: data.items[0].id (leave empty for the full body)
compiledChainTitle: compiled action chain ({{count}} total, executed in order)
compiledChainTitle_one: compiled action chain ({{count}} total, executed in order)
compiledChainTitle_other: compiled action chain ({{count}} total, executed in order)
compiledChainHint: This form edits only the 1st action; the rest are kept unchanged on save. To change the whole chain: go back to the list, click "Split" on the row to edit each action, or recompile with the AI assistant.
saveAsPlaceholderHint: Will be saved as an uncompiled placeholder — execution will be blocked; click the row-level "AI task" button to fill it back
httpAssertMismatch: Assertion (status code / response body; step fails if not matched)
sensitiveNeeded: Encrypted — enter a new password to modify it
smartExtractNeedsDesc: Smart extract needs a description and a generated regex
dslJsonNotAllowed: Do not put DSL JSON in the description — action parameters go in the form fields below; use natural language here (e.g. wait for the query result to appear)
invalidJsonExpected: Expected value is not valid JSON
aiTaskNotCompiled: Uncompiled: click "AI compile" to generate DSL first
